Problem Statement
A library uses numeric book IDs and places books with even IDs on one shelf and odd IDs on another. Write a C program to identify the shelf category for a given book ID using if-else.
Description
Read the book ID as an integer num. If num is divisible by 2, print "Even"; otherwise print "Odd". The library uses these exact labels for its two shelf categories.
Input Description
A single integer num.
Output Description
Print "Even" if num is even, otherwise print "Odd".
Sample Input
7
Sample Output
Odd
